complete_request_to_reply_flow: User opens stable current door pmp-app-current.html.
Door loads current map and then Route Guardian loader.
Route Guardian v14 requires user tap Open Latest App, then loads current inner app and injects support scripts.
Current inner v4/v3 loads pmp-home-single-v6.html and support patch scripts.
User opens Resident drawer, types normally into textarea#ask, and taps Run.
pmp-resident-xray-core patched residentRun builds X-Ray context first when active.
pmp-resident-lossless-readiness patched residentRun may intercept lossless/readiness/copy-lossless questions and write readiness report.
If no wrapper intercepts, original pmp-home-single-v6 residentRun reads ask/paste/localStorage/sessionStorage and routes by regex/keyword.
Original residentRun either triggers local storage/tool action, builds fixed local explanation, saves learning from paste, stages update request, or builds ChatGPT handoff under Show Work.
plain()/setStatus()/tool output functions write visible reply/work/warning and local ledgers.
Copy Work/Copy Lossless wrappers may copy visible work or vault packets to clipboard and open Shortcut.
No model request/response parsing stage was found.
flow_map_plain_language: USER INPUT -> Resident drawer textarea#ask -> patched residentRun wrappers -> X-Ray/readiness intercepts or original local residentRun -> local regex/rule branch -> local context/storage/DOM reads -> local reply/report/handoff packet -> reply/work/warning display -> session/local storage write -> optional clipboard/Shortcut/tool output. External/local AI reasoning stage: NOT PRESENT. Model response parsing: NOT PRESENT.
